title: NATURAL RESOURCE PROBLEMS AND SOLUTIONS
description: Exploration of the multiple components (ecological, social, political, ethical) of selected natural resource problems. Uses case studies to illustrate how social and biophysical characteristics of environmental problems influence the methods used to try to solve these problems and their potential for success.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: WF 4pm-5:20pm in PFSC 125 - Peavy Forest Science Center 125 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
